integrity: Complete analytical proof and runnable finite diagnostics; finite simulations are not used as proof of infinite-moment thresholds.
scientific_limitations: Exact Gaussian scalar-gradient OLS specialization of an unregularized, disjoint pilot/correction difference estimator; not the source experiments' regularized kernel implementation. Known stochastic-regression and control-variate tools are acknowledged; a specialized earlier derivation remains possible. No optimizer trajectory or cost guarantee.
title: Exact Student-mixture risk and optimal pilot allocation for model-assisted gradients
